package rulefixtures

import (
	"net/http"

	"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
)

// scenario for gin_handler_returns_multiple_response_shapes: Handlers that manually build several unrelated success payload shapes instead of delegating to clearer endpoints or render helpers.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

type UserSummary struct {
	ID    string `json:"id"`
	Name  string `json:"name"`
}

type UserDetail struct {
	ID      string `json:"id"`
	Name    string `json:"name"`
	Email   string `json:"email"`
	Address string `json:"address"`
	Phone   string `json:"phone"`
}

func GetUserHandler(c *gin.Context) {
	view := c.Query("view")

	if view == "detail" {
		c.JSON(http.StatusOK, UserDetail{
			ID:      "1",
			Name:    "John",
			Email:   "john@example.com",
			Address: "123 Main St",
			Phone:   "555-0100",
		})
		return
	}

	if view == "compact" {
		c.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{
			"id":       "1",
			"initials": "JD",
		})
		return
	}

	c.JSON(http.StatusOK, UserSummary{ID: "1", Name: "John"})
}
